sources.title: Spellbinding Fashion Royal - Halloween Shop Update
sources.note: Canonical announcement confirmed on the official news listing. Displayed publication date: 2026.10.22; publishedAt represents that date at midnight in the sale timezone, not a verified posting instant. The flash sale starts on the preceding evening. Original posters 1 and 2 contain all 33 flash-sale offers; Fashion Royal and Royal Point Exchange are outside this snapshot.

sources.title: Spellbinding Fashion Royal - Halloween Shop Update — original poster 1
sources.note: Primary evidence: original 940×3938 JPEG, visually read in overlapping native-resolution crops without OCR. Flash-sale introduction y=3041–3176; Round 1 y=3194–3938, four offers. Names, components, quantities, prices, stock and explicit dates checked independently twice. Order: the two full-width fashion cards, then bottom row left before right. Singular unmultiplied fashion components count as one each. The printed THU–FRI shorthand omits the Wednesday evening start; timestamps use the explicit October 21–23 dates.

sources.title: Spellbinding Fashion Royal - Halloween Shop Update — original poster 2
sources.note: Primary evidence: original 940×4323 JPEG, visually read in overlapping native-resolution crops without OCR. Round 2 y=9–1149 (9 offers), Round 3 y=1167–1663 (3), Round 4 y=1680–2474 (6), Round 5 y=2492–3202 (5), Round 6 y=3220–3952 (6), notes y=4000–4245. Names, components, quantities, prices, stock and dates independently reconciled. Order is top-to-bottom by rows, left before right. Explicit dates control over weekday shorthand. Eastern time changes from EDT to EST on November 1: Round 5 crosses that change. Stock is limited, is not replenished, and expires at the listed round end. Wished Pet Coupon III has an unnumbered per-account cap in addition to STOCK 25; the account cap is not inferred.
